items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR (AHA BLS)

Graduate of an Electroneurodiagnostic Technology Program Accredited by the Committee on Allied Health Education or equivalent formal training or registry eligible with 3-5 years experience in EEG/EvokedPotentials/EMG-Nerve Conduction Studies
2-3 years experience
Conducting Electroencephalograms (Long-Term, Routine and Ambulatory), multi-modality Evoked Potentials and Nerve Conduction Studies.
May be required to learn and perform additional testing as technology changes and new testing methodologies are introduced.
Communicate effectively with physicians, patients, clinical staff, department heads and administrative personnel. Must be able to track preventive maintenance needs of all department equipment.
Collect diagnostic quality data and generate the appropriate reports for physician interpretation.
Organize and adjust priorities accordingly.
Calibrate and troubleshoot all associated equipment.
Passion for excellence in the care of patients and provision of timely and quality service.
Effective clinical interaction regarding studies with ordering physicians.
Maintains accurate records as required.
Maintains confidentiality of all sensitive information.
Adheres to all policies and procedures as they apply to study performance and safety, attendance and personal appearance.
Sustains productive workload of scheduled studies
Ability to collect diagnostic quality data and generate the appropriate reports for physician interpretation.
Ability to organize and adjust priorities accordingly.
Ability to calibrate and troubleshoot all associated equipment.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, medical staff, management and other employees.
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
Basic computer skills.
Operational knowledge of all involved neurodiagnostic equipment.
Ability to ascertain clinically sound diagnostic studies.
Knowledge of safety standards for neurodiagnostic testing.
